author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** Backend GET /api/dashboard/live via axum::extract::ws::WebSocketUpgrade; subscribes to EventBus (#16); forwards typed DashboardEvent JSON. Frontend gloo-net WebSocket subscribe; onclose falls back to existing polling LocalResource. Same DashboardSnapshot DTO; diff payloads (NewCluster/NewSignal/VolumeBucketUpdated/ModeratorLoadDelta). Exponential backoff on reconnect. AC-7 boundary preserved.
